title: Madras High Court grants relief to DMK MLA Senthil Balaji, brother in horse-trading case lodged by TVK MLA
description: The Madras High Court on Wednesday granted anticipatory bail to DMK MLA and former Tamil Nadu Minister V Senthil Balaji and his brother RV Ashok Kumar in the ₹35 crore horse-trading case involving a Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam MLA [Senthil Balaji Vs State].Justice G K Ilanthiraiyan granted the relief subject to conditions.
